clips.title: The story
paras: At Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, Senani Thunderheart puts hunters to the test. She serves the Horde by sending travelers after the forest’s fiercest predators, a trial of skill that also thins the beasts near Horde territory.

At Splintertree Post, Senani Thunderheart carries on the tauren hunting traditions in Ashenvale. Far from Mulgore’s open plains, she sends Horde hunters against the forest’s great beasts to test their tracking and fighting skill. For Senani, the hunt is an honorable challenge and a way to survive in a wild, contested land.

Senani directs hunters toward three feared predators: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon. Their tokens are a paw, a head, and a claw. Claiming them marks a hunter’s passage and shows respect for the land and mastery of its fiercest beasts.
